data.one_liner: SPM-ready Flutter UI kit with responsive scaling, Dio HTTP, auth, secure storage, and 35+ widgets.
data.what_it_does: CoreKit bundles production-grade infrastructure, responsive design helpers, and 35+ custom UI widgets into a single package. It offers a pre-configured Dio HTTP client, JWT authentication, secure storage, runtime permissions, and location pickers.
use_when: You want a unified toolkit containing pre-built widgets, HTTP networking, and authentication for a new app.
You need responsive layout scaling utilities like .w, .h, .sp, and .r across multiple platforms.
You want Swift Package Manager readiness for iOS and macOS without legacy CocoaPods friction.
avoid_when: You prefer using small, single-purpose packages rather than an opinionated, all-in-one UI kit framework.
Your project relies on an entirely different custom networking or state management stack that conflicts with CoreKit's architecture.
strengths: Provides over 35 production-ready, pre-styled widgets with a consistent Ck prefix.
Includes built-in Dio networking with automatic token refresh and retry capabilities.
Supports Swift Package Manager (SPM) for modern iOS and macOS builds.
weaknesses: High coupling to a specific set of opinions and service classes inside a monolithic package.
Relies on numerous external dependencies which may increase maintenance or version conflict surface areas.
data.setup_notes: Import core_kit.dart and initialize via CoreKit configuration.
